review.acceptance_criterion: PASS only if V2 is genuinely self-describing and all preserved gates remain exact; otherwise return first stable code.

bootstrap.utf8: Create native Goal objective "Review one self-describing Goal-mailbox design only." Before files: send exact ACTIVE Goal receipt to /root, then wait. After one control, send BOUND and wait. After one review atom, send only its result, complete Goal, send terminal receipt, then return. No reuse or retry.

control_template.utf8: CONTROL|M=<MANIFEST_SHA256>|READ=D,F,S|CRITERION=Verify distinctness from rejected V1, self-contained executable directives, raw Goal receipt binding, exact wire bytes, all limits, loop breaker, 0/2, and no OMP dependency.|ACK=BOUND

goal_objective.utf8: Review one self-describing Goal-mailbox design only.

subject_atom.utf8: Review M now. Return DESIGN_V2|PASS|NONE or DESIGN_V2|FAIL|CODE.
